title: Where should you start?
intro: Ten short bands of three questions each, so one careless tap never moves you a whole level. It takes about two minutes, and you can retake it any time from your profile.

questions.prompt: Which greeting would you use at nine in the evening?
questions.explanation: Buenas noches covers the evening and the night; buenos días is used until about midday.

questions.prompt: Which word means 'house'?
questions.explanation: la casa is house. El queso is cheese, la calle is street and el caso is a case.

questions.prompt: Which word is spelled with ñ, not a plain n?
questions.explanation: año uses the separate letter ñ, pronounced like the 'ny' in canyon; writing it with a plain n gives a different, crude word.

questions.prompt: Which word means 'thank you'?
questions.explanation: Gracias is thank you; the others are please, hello and goodbye.

questions.prompt: Complete: Yo ___ profesora.
questions.explanation: A profession is part of who you are, so it takes ser, and the yo form is soy.

questions.prompt: Which one is correct?
questions.explanation: mano is feminine even though it ends in -o, so it takes la. It is one of the exceptions worth memorising.

questions.prompt: Complete: Las ciudades son muy ___.
questions.explanation: The adjective agrees with ciudades, which is feminine plural, so it ends in -as.

questions.prompt: Complete: Ella ___ española.
questions.explanation: Ella takes es.

questions.prompt: Complete: Mi hermano ___ enfadado hoy.
questions.explanation: Being angry is the state he is in rather than what he is, so it takes estar.

questions.prompt: Complete: ¿___ un banco por aquí?
questions.explanation: New, unspecified information takes hay with an indefinite article. Está would need a definite noun: ¿Dónde está el banco?

questions.prompt: Complete: Nosotros ___ en un piso pequeño.
questions.explanation: vivir is a regular -ir verb and its nosotros form is vivimos, not vivemos.

questions.prompt: Complete: El libro está ___ la mesa.
questions.explanation: En marks position: on or in something.

questions.prompt: Complete: No ___ salir esta noche porque trabajo mañana.
questions.explanation: poder changes o to ue wherever the stress falls on the stem, so the yo form is puedo.

questions.prompt: Complete: Mañana ___ a visitar a mis abuelos.
questions.explanation: ir a plus an infinitive is how Spanish expresses a plan, and the yo form of ir is voy.

questions.prompt: Complete: ___ hermanas viven en Sevilla.
questions.explanation: The unstressed possessive agrees with the thing possessed, and hermanas is plural, so mi becomes mis.

questions.prompt: Complete: ¿___ años tienes?
questions.explanation: Años is masculine plural, so the question word agrees: cuántos.

questions.prompt: Rewrite with two pronouns: Le doy el libro a Ana.
questions.explanation: le cannot stand next to lo, so it becomes se. Le lo doy does not exist in Spanish.

questions.prompt: Complete: ¿Has visto mis gafas? No ___ encuentro.
questions.explanation: gafas is feminine plural and it is the direct object, so the pronoun is las. The article is not shown, so the gender has to come from the noun itself.

questions.prompt: Complete: Todos los días ___ a las siete y media.
questions.explanation: levantarse is reflexive, so the pronoun matches the subject: me levanto.

questions.prompt: Complete: A nosotros ___ interesa el arte.
questions.explanation: Interesar works like gustar and takes the indirect object pronoun nos.

questions.prompt: Complete: Esta semana ___ mucho en la oficina.
questions.explanation: esta semana is a period that reaches the present, so peninsular Spanish uses the pretérito perfecto.

questions.prompt: Complete: Cuando era niño, ___ todos los veranos a la playa.
questions.explanation: A repeated habit in the past takes the imperfecto, and ir is one of its three irregulars: iba.

questions.prompt: ¿Cuál es la forma correcta del imperativo (tú) de 'abrir'?
questions.explanation: The tú imperative of regular -ir verbs matches the él/ella present form, so abrir gives abre; abrid is the vosotros form.

questions.prompt: Complete: Este regalo es ___ ti.
questions.explanation: Para marks the recipient of something.

questions.prompt: Which is the correct way to tell a friend to buy it?
questions.explanation: The pronoun attaches to an affirmative order, and the written accent keeps the stress where it was: cómpralo.

questions.prompt: Complete: Hoy hay ___ gente en el mercado.
questions.explanation: mucho modifies a noun and agrees with it, and gente is feminine singular. muy can only modify an adjective or an adverb.

questions.prompt: Complete: ___ a su hermana, pero no ___ dónde vive.
questions.explanation: conocer is used for being acquainted with a person, and saber for knowing a fact.

questions.prompt: Complete: Hace dos años que ___ español.
questions.explanation: Hace dos años que with the present says the action is still going on.

questions.prompt: Complete: A mí me ___ los idiomas.
questions.explanation: Interesar agrees with what is interesting, and los idiomas is plural.

questions.prompt: Complete: Ayer ___ mucho tráfico.
questions.explanation: haber in the preterite is hubo, and it is always singular.

questions.prompt: Complete: Salgo ___ Madrid mañana.
questions.explanation: para marks the destination you set off towards.

questions.prompt: Complete: Cuando ___ el teléfono, yo dormía.
questions.explanation: The single event that interrupts takes the preterite; the background takes the imperfect.

questions.prompt: Complete: El lunes ___ tiempo para revisar el informe.
questions.explanation: The future of tener inserts a d into a shortened stem, giving tendr-, so the yo form is tendré.

questions.prompt: No contesta el teléfono. Which sentence guesses why?
questions.explanation: The future in -ré also expresses probability in the present, so estará means he is probably in a meeting.

questions.prompt: ¿Cuál es la forma correcta del condicional de 'tener' para 'yo'?
questions.explanation: tener uses the irregular stem tendr- for both the future and the conditional; the conditional adds -ía, so tendría is correct, while tendré is the future and tenía/tuve are past tenses.

questions.prompt: Complete: Me dijo que ___ al día siguiente.
questions.explanation: A future promise reported in the past becomes the conditional vendría.

questions.prompt: Complete: No creo que ___ hoy, está muy ocupado.
questions.explanation: no creer denies the assertion, so the clause takes the present subjunctive. Creo que would take the indicative: creo que viene.

questions.prompt: Which correctly tells someone not to say it to anyone?
options: No se lo digas a nadie.
No lo se digas a nadie.
questions.answer: No se lo digas a nadie.
questions.explanation: A negative order uses the present subjunctive and the pronouns move in front of the verb.

questions.prompt: Complete: Cuando ___ a casa, llámame.
questions.explanation: cuando pointing at a moment that has not happened yet takes the present subjunctive, and Spanish never uses a future tense after it.

questions.prompt: Complete: ___ rompió el vaso sin querer.
questions.explanation: The accidental se takes the indirect object after it: se me rompió.

questions.prompt: Complete: El escritor ___ novela leí es español.
questions.explanation: cuyo agrees with the thing owned, and novela is feminine.

questions.prompt: Complete: ___ me molesta es el ruido.
questions.explanation: lo que refers to a whole idea rather than to a particular noun.

questions.prompt: Complete: Estaba cansado; ___, terminó el trabajo.
questions.explanation: sin embargo marks a contrast; por lo tanto would state a consequence.

questions.prompt: Complete: Es más difícil ___ parece.
questions.explanation: A comparison against a clause takes de lo que.

questions.prompt: You have not found a flat yet. Complete: Busco un piso que ___ terraza.
questions.explanation: The flat may not exist yet, so the relative clause takes the subjunctive. Tengo un piso que tiene terraza would use the indicative, because that flat is real.

questions.prompt: Which is correct on a sign outside a block of flats?
questions.explanation: In the passive se the verb agrees with the thing affected, and pisos is plural, so it is venden.

questions.prompt: You do not know whether it will rain. Complete: Aunque ___, saldremos a caminar.
questions.explanation: aunque takes the subjunctive when the speaker is conceding something unknown. Aunque llueve would mean it is raining and you know it.

questions.prompt: ¿Cómo se despide un correo formal?
questions.explanation: Atentamente is the formal sign-off; the others are informal.
